_comment: Envelope facts OBSERVED during the run, kept SEPARATE from RUN_METADATA.json on purpose. The freeze record was written before the run and read by every pre-flight; editing it afterwards so it agrees with the evidence is CD-8b's own sin in mirror image, even when the edit would only fill in a placeholder. Its 'pending' fields stay pending; this file answers them. Nothing here is a finding about the game.

grass_field_differs_between_modes.meaning: A REAL caveat on X08's numbers, recorded rather than smoothed over: in logic mode the grass field's stone tier binds no height map and no region map, so X08's CPU frame times were taken with that tier not fully stood up. Not a defect claim -- headless has no renderer to bind against -- but X08's per-site figures are not the same workload S01 was rendering.

instrumentation_overhead_note: Measured with tools/gate_f/run_segment.sh --overhead at the candidate, scene=world, LOGIC mode, 30 s x 2 windows per condition at [-25.4, 4.93, -15.6], order off/telemetry/recording/recording/telemetry/off. Means: off 6.406, telemetry 6.034, telemetry+recording@0.5Hz 5.937 ms/frame. Both deltas vs off are NEGATIVE and below the 1.072 ms/frame noise floor: read as 'under ~1.07 ms/frame', NOT as zero and NOT as a speed-up. IMPORTANT GAP, unchanged from the previous run and now known to matter far more than it looked: frames written 0, because a headless process cannot render, so the recorder's framebuffer-grab-and-encode cost was NOT measured. In capture mode it is not a ~1 ms/frame effect -- S01's route.csv puts a rendered 1920x1080 frame at 12,721 ms. The overhead run is filed at overhead/ and its INVENTORY.json correctly reports INCOMPLETE with '30 continuous frames were planned and not written'.
